title: pokerface.yaml v0.1
description: The build input committed with the application (docs/spec/pokerface-yaml.md). The schema mirrors the shape the parser enforces; the implementation adds the cross-field rules the schema language cannot express (duplicate tag rendering, empty renders, the bare-`.`-as-float rejection).

image.description: <host>[:<port>]/<owner>/<repo>, lowercase, no scheme, no tag, no digest.

url.description: The registry base URL; http:// is for local development registries only.

context.description: The build context directory, relative to the repository root. Quote a bare `.` — YAML's core schema reads `.` as a float.

target.description: The Dockerfile stage; empty or absent means the final stage.

args.description: Build args passed to the builder. Values must be strings — quote numbers.

tagRule.description: A literal tag or a template of literal segments and {{ placeholder }} holes.
